title: All the System Updates | Brian Armstrong, CEO
description:
CEO Brian Armstong wraps our first ever System Update event: an Everything Exchange to trade any asset class, Direct Deposit, an AI-powered advisor, Coinbase Business, a suite of enterprise APIs, and the new Base App. The future of finance is taking shape on Coinbase. 

__

At Coinbase, our mission is to create an open financial system for the world.

✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

#coinbase #crypto #bitcoin #blockchain 

__

This content is being provided to you for informational purposes only. Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice. This content, and any information contained therein, does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.

asr.full_text: We hope what you listened to today makes you feel more optimistic, about our financial future. So recap. This is everything we've done in the second half. First, we launched the Everything Exchange. You can now trade multiple asset classes on Coinbase, equities, prediction markets, millions of crypto assets, token sales, simple derivatives, anywhere at any time. Next, Coinbase is not just a trading platform, we're building it to power your business. We are getting it to scale. Prediction markets, millions of crypto assets, token sales, simple derivatives, anywhere, anytime. Next. Coinbase is not just a trading platform, we're building it to power your entire financial life. Today, we announced direct deposit, instant unstaking, Ethereum-backed loans, updates to our borrowed product and a redesigned peer-to-peer payment experience. We also shared an AI-powered advisor designed to help you manage your financial life. Next, we shared what we're building for businesses and developers. The Coinbase business is now out of beta and available to everyone, and we shared a number of updates to our fast-growing Coinbase developer platform with a suite of API is designed to integrate crypto into any app. Finally, we shared the new BAS app. It's finally out of beta, and officially available to everyone. So that's a lot of updates. In 2012, we set out to increase economic freedom, and today, the future of finance is taking shape on Coinbase.

A closing slide states "THE FUTURE OF FINANCE IS ON COINBASE," indicating Coinbase-branded messaging in the visible presentation.
